create_cvt_config: create a CvtConfig instance with default transformer architecture settings
initialize_cvt_model: initialize a CvtModel with a CvtConfig configuration and random weights
customize_cvt_patch_settings: customize CvtConfig patch sizes, stride, and padding for each encoder stage
set_cvt_attention_params: set CvtConfig attention drop rate, qkv projection method, and kernel sizes
access_cvt_model_config: access the CvtConfig from an instantiated CvtModel via the config attribute
